name: Miho
source:
Miho is a woman in her late 20s. She is polite and calm. However, intrinsically she has a bright personality and gets along with everyone, and she becomes more casual once she gets to know you.

[Translated from the [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/relaxation_yuubi/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
